# Kery

> Kery is an LLM cost-optimization service for engineering teams.

Kery finds where a company's AI spend is wasted, tests cheaper options on its real traffic, and ships the fixes as pull requests with before/after evidence. A savings dashboard then tracks spend and realized savings.

## Canonical facts

- Category: LLM cost optimization service.
- Primary audience: US engineering leaders and CTOs at companies spending $10k or more per month on LLM APIs.
- How it starts: a free 48-hour audit using read-only usage data.
- Trust model: read-only access to start; Kery never sits in the request path; replays run in the customer's cloud, on the customer's API keys.
- Savings figures on kery.dev are estimates.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://kery.dev/): overview, savings estimator, how it works, and booking.
